AgentCommandBody.title: AgentCommandBody
AgentCommandBody.description: The whole vocabulary of the panel: start or stop. Never a program or its arguments.

AgentStatusOut.title: AgentStatusOut
AgentStatusOut.description:
What is known about the paired agent. While it is not connected the process state is
`unknown`: an old report is never presented as the current state.

AgentSync.title: AgentSync
AgentSync.description:
The agent's report. Extra fields are refused, so nothing else (a credential, for
instance) can be sent here by mistake.

ComponentStatus.title: ComponentStatus
ComponentStatus.description: Real state only. `last_heartbeat_at` stays null until a worker actually reports one.

PairingCodeOut.title: PairingCodeOut
PairingCodeOut.description: Shown once to the signed-in owner, to be typed into the agent on their PC.

TelegramChannelsOut.title: TelegramChannelsOut
TelegramChannelsOut.description:
What was registered by hand. `access_status` is always `not_verified`: saving an id does
not prove that the bot can read the source or write to the destination.

WorkspaceUpdate.title: WorkspaceUpdate
WorkspaceUpdate.description: Partial update guarded by optimistic concurrency: `version` is the one the client read.

AgentToken.description: Token of a paired local agent
